optional_positive_key_heap_trie_encoding: Encode index j by positive j+1; remove leading one and use remaining bits as branch choices, storing values also at internal nodes.
scope: Counts visits/branch choices only, not big-integer bit extraction, construction, memory, proof checking, VM reductions, wall-clock time or end-to-end speedup.
formal_requirement: Prove pure-inductive trie lookup after list construction equals nth_error; apply existing checker soundness through a refinement lemma. No trusted array primitive or external lookup oracle.
